title: Wine Ready-to-Drink Window
app: Meater probes, Anova Precision Cooker sessions, Instant Pot logs, wine-fridge sensors, ESPHome kitchen sensors, and pantry inventory feeds via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pantry:item item_type=wine
| stats count(eval(days_to_best_window<=30 AND days_to_best_window>=0)) as ready_bottles by fridge_zone
| where ready_bottles>0
| sort - ready_bottles
description: Uses Wine inventory exports telemetry to monitor how many bottles are entering their preferred drinking window in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for collections that should be enjoyed before the window closes, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Wine inventory exports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers how many bottles are entering their preferred drinking window so you can spot collections that should be enjoyed before the window closes before it becomes annoying.
